newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to select aircraft bid this month - official.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to select aircraft bid this month - official.

text.p: Turkey will choose this month between aicraft production proposals being made by Boeing Co, McDonnell Douglas Corp and Airbus Industrie, a Turkish official said on Monday.
Turkey has sought the bids to meet the demand of Turkish Airlines for 54 passenger aircraft.
"Revised proposals from Boeing, Airbus and McDonnell Douglas will be made by May 15," an official at the prime minister's office told Reuters.
"In the third week of May the selection will be made," he said.
He said officials from Boeing had arrived in Ankara to discuss their revised proposal with Turkish officials and were expected to remain in Turkey until the weekend.
Airbus will also be called for further talks this week, he said.
Turkish officials say the three companies have accepted Turkey's proposal that the aircraft be produced under a 50 percent offset agreement.
